parameters.content:
## RSS Summary

Every hour -> read feed -> dedupe by guid -> LLM summary -> Notion page.

**Duplicate protection**: each article guid is written once. Re-running the schedule never duplicates pages, even if the feed republishes the same item.

**Failure behaviour**: LLM and Notion calls retry 3 times, then log to workflow_errors. The schedule keeps running.

**Before activating**: set the feed URL in `Fetch Feed`, a Postgres credential on the two SQL nodes, a DeepSeek credential (Header Auth) on `LLM Summarize`, and your Notion token + database id in `Create Notion Page`.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO processed_keys (key, workflow, payload, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, 'claimed')
ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
  SET status = 'claimed',
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE processed_keys.status <> 'done'
    AND processed_keys.updated_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
RETURNING key, payload

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'deepseek-chat', temperature: 0.2, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'Summarise the article in 3 short bullet points, in the language of the source. Then add one line: why it matters for someone building AI products. Plain text, no markdown headings.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Title: ' + $json.title + '\n\n' + $json.content } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: 'YOUR_NOTION_DATABASE_ID' }, properties: { Name: { title: [ { text: { content: $('Build Keys').item.json.title } } ] }, Link: { url: $('Build Keys').item.json.link } } , children: [ { object: 'block', type: 'paragraph', paragraph: { rich_text: [ { type: 'text', text: { content: ($json.choices && $json.choices[0] && $json.choices[0].message) ? $json.choices[0].message.content : '' } } ] } } ] }) }}

INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow, node, message, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb)

UPDATE processed_keys
SET status = 'done',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE key = $1
RETURNING key
